name: Economics
notes: The department page writes course codes as ECO / STT; the registrar catalog uses ECON / STAT, which is the form used here.
An overall average of C or better is required in the economics courses counted toward the minor.
The department will accept up to two transfer courses for the elective requirement.
STAT 213 cannot be used for the economics minor - excluded from the elective filter.

requirementGroups.label: Intermediate theory
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Minor Requirements: ECO 207: Intermediate Microeconomics; ECO 209: Intermediate Macroeconomics

requirementGroups.label: 200-level economics electives (3)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Three 200-level economics electives. The department will accept up to two transfer courses for the economics elective requirement. STT 213 cannot be used for the economics minor.
